messages:
sam: Heads-up: planning a staged deploy tonight — runtime 2.3.0 -> api 1.8.4 -> router 4.1. Window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Any cross-service blockers?
lee: Noted. Console has a schema migration at ~02:15, need sequencing. Do we have a pin order?
maria: Recommend pin runtime first, then api, then router. If runtime rollback happens, api should be unpinned immediately.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: runtime@2.3.0 -> api@1.8.4 -> router@4.1. Scheduled start 02:00 UTC. :robot_face:
lee: Console migration depends on api header change (x-rdwd-vary). Can we run api canary behind header gate?
sam: Plan: api canary 5% for 10m, 25% for 10m, then full. If p95 latency regresses >200ms or >2% 5xx we halt. ops-runner: I suggest 5m steady then 10m ramp to be conservative.
maria: Rollback criteria (explicit): >2% 5xx across router or api OR p95 +200ms vs baseline for 2 consecutive windows (5m). Also monitor console-schema-errors signal.
ursula: I'll pre-seed dashboards and enable tracing for these routes. Add the KV eviction and route-backpressure charts.
lee: Also we should keep console feature-flagged off until router 4.1 confirms availability.
sam: Release notes draft (will post to #release-notes after deploy): "runtime: perf fixes for KV cache; api: header contract change; router: backpressure and retry tuning; console: schema migration"
maria: Emergency playbook: if api canary fails, rollback api to 1.8.3 and pause console migration. If runtime fails, unpin api and router and trigger rollback across all.
deploy-bot: preflight results: infra capacity OK, image signatures verified, smoke tests queued.
lee: I ran a staging smoke pass for api+runtime interplay, small header parsing nit but nothing blocking. :thumbsup:
sam: OK. kicking at 02:00 UTC. Keep all rollback signals here and ping @maria for emergency unpin.
ops-runner: Will be on-call during the window, monitor alerts channel.
maria: I'll watch metrics and own the rollback call if needed. :triangular_flag_on_post:
deploy-bot: post-deploy hook will run migration-checker and e2e-smoke. If migration-checker fails, it will mark the deploy as failed and queue rollback.
sam: Thanks — see you in the window.
